text:
julie - marketing lead: Quick kickoff for Auric customer story — goal: gated one-pager + teaser blog + webinar mention. Need interview, release signoff, and assets by next Thurs.
alex - producer: I can interview Raja Tue 11am PT (30m). Will record, transcribe, and draft two quote variants.
raja (customer): Tue 11am works. I can share conservative metrics beforehand: 2.8x throughput, ~38% cost reduction, improved p99.
mira - legal: If we publish exact numbers, we need a signed release. Send quote drafts + transcript; I can turn around redlines within 24h.
leo - design: Ill reserve hero slot and gated PDF template. Need final quote + logo usage by Wed EOD to finish.
sam - sales: For gated downloads route leads to AE queue and include webinar invite. Julie, send the SFDC campaign name so Ops can wire it.
julie - marketing lead: Will create the campaign. @pipeline-bot please add follow-up to assign Auric brief downloads to sam.sales when the form goes live.
pipeline-bot: Task created: "Auric brief - route downloads to sam.sales"  due 2026-04-09
alex - producer: Draft quote for review: "Redwood Inference cut Auric's per-token cost by ~38% and improved p99 latency, enabling faster customer interactions." Mira — quick eyes?
mira - legal: Looks fine as approximate language. If Raja confirms exact 38% we can use precise figure after release.
raja (customer): I can confirm the 38% figure and will sign the release after the call.
julie - marketing lead: Timeline recap: Alex runs interview Tue 11am; Raja provides verification slides; Alex delivers transcript + quotes within 24h; Mira returns legal signoff within 24h; Leo finalizes assets Wed EOD; Julie publishes gated brief + teaser blog + schedules webinar.
leo - design: Noted. Ill queue the banner and PDF build.
sam - sales: Ill prep AE nurture + 2-slide SDR cheat-sheet once we have the final quotes.
julie - marketing lead: Thanks — Ill post the calendar invite after legal clears quotes. :sparkles:
